boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented study environments in Fenwick Library, with their working style and access constraints noted.

cards.title: Research Commons
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a project partner and use the open seating plan for collaborative work; public computers with selected productivity software are also available.
cards.short_summary: An active, open-plan research and group-work area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Research Commons is an Active Study area designed for collaboration and interaction, with open seating and PCs running selected productivity software.
cards.access_notes: Located on Fenwick Library's second floor; follow the library's current building hours.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library, second floor
cards.notes: Settle in for a quiet reading session among scores, books, recordings, and videos; ask the music subject librarian for research help when needed.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study library built around Mason's music collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick's Music Library supports Mason's music programs, holds scores, books and recordings, and is designated a quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Fenwick Library Tour - Music Library and Data & Digital Scholarship Services
cards.access_notes: Located on Fenwick's second floor; use materials according to library borrowing and access policies.

cards.title: Data & Digital Scholarship Services
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use the collaborative areas when your assignment needs specialized software, data help, GIS support, or a research consultation rather than silent study.
cards.short_summary: An active digital-research space with collaborative areas and specialized technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Data & Digital Scholarship Services is an active study space offering collaborative areas, special software and technology, consultations, appointments, and workshops.
cards.source_title: Fenwick Library Tour - Music Library and Data & Digital Scholarship Services
cards.access_notes: Located on Fenwick's second floor; consultations and appointments are available through DDSS.

cards.entity_name: Special Collections Research Center Reading Room
cards.title: Special Collections Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library, Special Collections Research Center
cards.notes: Plan a primary-source research session here and follow the posted special-collections handling rules for rare books, archives, photographs, maps, and documents.
cards.short_summary: A supervised reading room for hands-on work with primary-source holdings.
cards.evidence_claim: All visitors may use Special Collections in its Reading Room, subject to routine policies protecting fragile and valuable materials.
cards.source_title: Fenwick Library Tour - Special Collections & UDTS
cards.access_notes: Open to all users of the collections, with routine Special Collections policies and staff supervision.

cards.title: Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 2001, Fenwick Library
cards.notes: Use the formal reading-room setup for independent or small-group work when it is not scheduled for an approved academic or cultural event.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped formal reading room with flexible study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick's Reading Room and Public Event Space has furniture configurable for individual or group study seating and is technology equipped.
cards.source_title: Your Support Can Build A Library for the Future
cards.access_notes: Room 2001 may be reserved for qualifying Mason events; availability for study can vary around scheduled events.

cards.title: Third-Floor Compact Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library, compact shelving area
cards.notes: Choose a desk among the compact stacks when you need a quiet, library-defined silent-study setting; posted instructions explain how the movable shelving works.
cards.short_summary: Silent study spaces integrated with Fenwick's compact book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick's third floor is primarily quiet study space, and study rooms and spaces in compact shelving areas are silent study areas.
cards.access_notes: Located on Fenwick's third floor in the compact shelving area; observe silent-study expectations.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Head upstairs with solo reading or writing that benefits from a library-designated silent environment, and keep conversations for an active-study area.
cards.short_summary: A full floor designated for silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick Library's fourth floor is a silent study area.
cards.access_notes: Located on Fenwick's fourth floor; maintain the library's silent-study environment.

cards.title: Graduate Silent Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Room 5003, Fenwick Library fifth floor
cards.notes: Graduate students can use this room for individual silent work; keep it strictly solo because group study is not allowed in Room 5003.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated silent room for graduate students' individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Any graduate student may use Fenwick's Silent Reading Room 5003 for individual silent work; group study is not allowed.
cards.access_notes: Graduate-student access only; Room 5003 is on Fenwick's fifth floor and follows posted Silent Reading Room policies.

cards.title: Graduate Student Reserved Carrels
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library fifth floor, New Addition
cards.notes: Reserve a carrel for focused graduate research when you need a desk, power, and lockable storage; collect the cabinet key at the Information Desk.
cards.short_summary: Reservable fifth-floor graduate desks with power and lockable storage.
cards.evidence_claim: Currently registered graduate students may reserve fifth-floor carrels for up to 45 days; each has power outlets and two lockable storage units.
cards.access_notes: Currently registered graduate students may reserve a carrel; a Mason ID is required to check out cabinet keys after reserving.

cards.title: Dissertation Writers Rooms
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library fifth floor
cards.notes: Apply for a shared, short-term desk when you are a graduate student progressing on thesis or dissertation work and need a quiet writing base.
cards.short_summary: Shared reservable desks for graduate thesis and dissertation writing.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick's Dissertation Writers Rooms provide short-term reservable desks in a shared fifth-floor space for eligible graduate students.
cards.access_notes: Graduate students in good standing may reserve desks for up to 45 days; access uses a unique door code or individual keys.
